notes: This contract pins a bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 variant-record Discriminant Enumerator semantic slice. Supplied bracketed ranges expand over the selected enumerated data type's source-table declaration order, and a discriminant enumerator reached directly or through a range cannot determine more than one named alternative after composition. HLAother is retained internally as the complement of explicit members, not a literal enumerator. An enumeration with no declared members remains representable as incomplete DIF. The precise table candidate exports broad clause-4 provenance (RL-049); the Annex C.3 continuation candidate exports clause-7 provenance despite the visible C.3 context (RL-050). This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
